legal.faq.title: Questions and answers
legal.faq.description: Quick answers about documents, data, transactions and security.
legal.faq.status.q: Is this project a real bank?
legal.faq.status.a: No. {bank} is a demonstration interface without a banking license or real financial transactions.
legal.faq.data.a: Demo settings are stored in this browser's cookies and are not sent to a banking system.
legal.faq.cancel.q: Can a completed transaction be cancelled?
legal.faq.cancel.a: In the demo you can open the transaction and repeat its flow. In a real bank, refunds depend on the payment type and agreement.
legal.faq.fraud.q: What should I do if I suspect fraud?
legal.faq.fraud.a: Never share verification codes, temporarily lock the card and contact support through an official channel.
legal.faq.support.q: How can I request an explanation?
legal.faq.support.a: Open support in the app and specify the document and clause you need help with.
legal.faq.cookies.a: Yes. Analytics, marketing and personalization cookies are managed in Privacy settings.
